42: /// ## What it does
43: /// Checks for negated `==` operators.
44: ///
45: /// ## Why is this bad?
46: /// Negated `==` operators are less readable than `!=` operators. When testing
47: /// for non-equality, it is more common to use `!=` than `==`.
48: ///
49: /// ## Example
50: /// ```python
51: /// not a == b
52: /// ```
53: ///
54: /// Use instead:
55: /// ```python
56: /// a != b
57: /// ```
58: ///
59: /// ## References
60: /// - [Python documentation: Comparisons](https://docs.python.org/3/reference/expressions.html#comparisons)
61: #[derive(ViolationMetadata)]
62: pub(crate) struct NegateEqualOp {
63:     left: String,
64:     right: String,
65: }
66: 
67: impl AlwaysFixableViolation for NegateEqualOp {
68:     #[derive_message_formats]
69:     fn message(&self) -> String {
70:         let NegateEqualOp { left, right } = self;
71:         format!("Use `{left} != {right}` instead of `not {left} == {right}`")
72:     }
73: 
74:     fn fix_title(&self) -> String {
75:         "Replace with `!=` operator".to_string()
76:     }
77: }

216:     fn record_unary_op(&mut self, op: UnaryOp, operand: &Expr) {

222:             self.unary_last_left = "unary".to_string();
223:         } else if operand.is_name_expr() {
224:             self.unary_last_left = "name".to_string();
225:         } else if operand.is_call_expr() {
226:             self.unary_last_left = "call".to_string();
227:         } else {
228:             self.unary_last_left = "other".to_string();
229:         }
230:         self.unary_last_right.clear();
231:         if matches!(self.unary_last_op, Some(UnaryOp::Not)) {
232:             self.unary_last_right = "not".to_string();
233:         } else if matches!(self.unary_last_op, Some(UnaryOp::Invert)) {
234:             self.unary_last_right = "invert".to_string();
235:         } else if matches!(self.unary_last_op, Some(UnaryOp::UAdd)) {
236:             self.unary_last_right = "pos".to_string();
237:         } else if matches!(self.unary_last_op, Some(UnaryOp::USub)) {
238:             self.unary_last_right = "neg".to_string();
